senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. שׁוּף II)to crush.—Part. pass. שָׁפוּי, pl. שְׁפוּיִין crushed, humble, contrite (= b. h. דַּכָּא).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 2:9">Tosef. Ḥag. II, 9</cite> <he>עניו וש׳</he> humble and contrite; <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 7:1">Tosef. Snh. VII, 1</cite> <he>וש׳</he> (only); Y. ib. I, 19ᶜ.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>דווין וש׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ושפופין</he>) broken down and crushed (poor); a. e.

senses.gloss: to rub, smooth, plane.—Part. pass. as ab.

units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:14">Koh. R. to XII, 14</cite> two paths <he>אחד ש׳ ואחד מלא וכ׳</he> one smooth, and the other full of thorns and pebbles.—

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>, v. <cite ref="T01146"><he>רָתַק</he></cite>.

units: <cite ref="Chullin 125a:13">Ḥull. 125ᵃ</cite> <he>קולית שש׳ וכ׳</he> a thigh-bone which one sawed through lengthwise.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 42a">Ab. Zar. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>ישראל שש׳ ע״ז וכ׳</he> if an Israelite chipped off an idol whether for his own purpose (to use the wood) or for its sake (to improve its appearance).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 49b:9">Ib. 49ᵇ</cite>. Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵃ bot. <he>גזלו ושִׁיפָּהוּ</he> if he took a block by force and planed it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 1</cite> <he>שפת הימנה וכ׳</he> (read: <cite ref="U01734"><he>שפה</he></cite>) if he filed off a part of it and made of it &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְשׁוּפֶּה</he>; pl. <he>מְשׁוּפִּים</he>, <he>מְשׁוּפִּין</he>. Y. Gitt. l. c. <he>גזלו מש׳</he> if he took it planed. Y. Succ. I, 52ᶜ top <he>במש׳ לכלים</he> (not <he>בכלים</he>) when the boards are planed preparatory to making them into utensils; a. e.

senses.gloss: to smooth, polish, Kel. XIV, 5 משׁיְשַׁפֶּנּוּ Ar.; Ned. 56ᵇ משׁיְשַׁפֵּם, v. שׁוּף II.—Trnsf. to pacify, give satisfaction. Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᵇ המבטל … חייב לשַׁפּוֹת לו if a tenant or an agent neglects his neighbor’s field, he must indemnify him; ib. IX, beg. 12ᵃ

to leave smooth places, (cmp. חָלַק Hif.) to plant wide apart. Y. Orl. I, beg. 60ᶜ לקורות במְשַׁפֶּה (or במַשְׁפֶּה Hif.) when he plants the trees wide apart, it is an indication that he wants to raise them for beams, opp. רָצַף.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:4">B. Bath. V, 4</cite> <he>הגדילו לא יְשַׁפֶּה</he> (or <cite ref="J00702"><he>יַשְׁפֶּה</he></cite>) if they (the trees bought in a person’s field) grew large, he (the owner of the field) has no right to smooth the field (cut the trees down).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:4">Ib.</cite> <he>הגדילו ישפה</he> when they are grown large, he (the owner of the trees) may cut them (in order to use the ground they occupy); a. e.
